profiles.title: Check a Czech LPIS drawing
profiles.applies_to: Farmer drawings and proposed changes to a land block. A private parcel, a working sketch and a DPB change proposal serve different purposes.

steps.title: Choose the right drawing
steps.text: Sign in to your authorised LPIS account. Choose a private agricultural parcel, working sketch or DPB change proposal before drawing.

steps.title: Check the outline
steps.text: The official guide describes drawing, editing and coordinate or SHP import. Our GeoJSON and KML files have not been verified for that import route.

steps.title: Check the saved result
steps.text: Save explicitly and inspect the result. Some parcel types are clipped to the land block when saved.

steps.title: Keep the next step separate
steps.text: A DPB proposal needs the authority's register-update process. A private drawing is not a submitted subsidy application. Keep any actual reply separately.

limits: Exact import attributes, coordinate text grammar and authenticated filing have not been verified.
The drawing manual does not establish data or imagery redistribution rights.

profiles.title: Take an outline to Mijn percelen
profiles.applies_to: Manual GPS-file handoff to parcel registration, not a complete Gecombineerde opgave application.

steps.title: Check the saved file
steps.text: Review the field outlines here and download KML. Confirm the intended year and holding in your own Mijn percelen account.

steps.title: Upload the shapes
steps.text: The retained RVO instructions describe GPS, then Uploaden GPS-bestand. Select the KML file.

steps.title: Choose the outline to use
steps.text: Inspect the uploaded GPS shapes. Adopting a shape is a separate step; check the GPS-vlakken layer and resulting field details.

steps.title: Finish in the official service
steps.text: Follow the current saving and sending instructions. Keep the actual confirmation. Changing parcel registration does not by itself correct an already sent aid application.

authority_import_formats: KML, through the documented GPS-upload route
limits: Live upload and acceptance are unverified. The detailed guide could not be refreshed in the latest lookup; use its current instructions.
GeoJSON and this app's correction JSON are not verified RVO import files. Public PDOK outlines do not establish your private claim.

profiles.title: Change owned or rented land records
profiles.applies_to: The owned and rented land register (EPVP) inside GSAA. These steps are not a general guide to every GSAA map or claim correction.

steps.title: Open the current register
steps.text: Use PPA's official instructions. In GSAA, open the current campaign in editing mode and check the last properly sent register.

steps.title: Make and send the changes
steps.text: Update the owned or rented land records in GSAA and complete its sending step.

steps.title: Deliver the separate change form
steps.text: The PPA notice also requires the change form through slovensko.sk. Mark that it concerns the land register; a GSAA edit alone is insufficient for this process.

steps.title: Keep both confirmations
steps.text: Keep evidence of the GSAA action and delivery of the change form. Record actual dates and references here; do not assume a deadline from the transition notice.

limits: Geometry import formats, CRS, drawing controls and general claim-correction deadlines remain unverified.
The notice describes the EPVP move to GSAA from 16 July 2026, not a blanket requirement for every field edit.
